notes.title: Bug Fixes (March 16th)
notes.content:
Yo Ricardos, another update is here!

[list]
[*] Language choice no longer reverts back to the default value when reopening the game
[*] Secret Stage 2 now has a death plane (oops)
[/list]

There won't be many more updates for this game from now on, I will start focusing instead of other projects (and things in life).

I hope you keep enjoying the game!

notes.title: First Update (Post-release, March 15th)
notes.content:
Hey fellow Ricardos, here's an update to fix a few bugs that were present in the previous version.

It fixes:
[list]
[*] Framerate cap issues (now it caps at 60 during normal stages, and 24 during the credits);
[*] White screen after summoning the Exit portal in the Front Desk;
[*] A few more.
[/list]
That should be all for now, I hope you continue enjoying the game!

(By the way, have you found all the cheat codes yet?)
